failures: D12: one element outside landmarks (axe, moderate).
notes: One prompt, one plan of eight steps, 26 minutes, no follow-up needed. Bolt wrote a real database with 20 seeded bookings (11 Confirmed, 5 Pending, 4 Cancelled), a session-based login, search, status filter, detail view with an editable status that survives a reload, and a CSV export. The one weak spot is accessibility: one element sits outside a landmark. Bolt says it could not open the app in a browser, so the phone layout is reasoned from code — we checked the three widths ourselves and found no sideways scrolling.

pricing.free_plan: Free plan with a daily token allowance; publishing to a bolt.host subdomain worked without a paid plan
